0022600097.text: Washington hosts Toronto in the Wizards' second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten at 1-0 after one game each. The Wizards sit 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East, while the Raptors are 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and Felix Okpara is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision; Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 134-125 defeat in Washington on February 28, 2026.
